name: manual_c15cb8
claim: check-guard-sync-divergence.sh's WORKSPACE_ROOT defaults to the parent directory of the canonical repo root -- when the canonical repo being pushed from is itself a disposable/scratch clone sitting directly under /tmp (a common pattern for isolating risky git-history-surgery operations), this default silently expands the scan to every unrelated scratch clone under /tmp, producing false-positive GUARD_SYNC_E_DIVERGENCE blocks on totally unrelated pushes. Fix: run the push from a workspace directory that has no other sibling git repos (move/clone the canonical repo into its own isolated parent dir), or verify the flagged 'siblings' are genuinely unrelated scratch work before treating the block as blocking.

decisions.notes: Hit this twice in one session (2026-08-09): an orama-mapfile-fix push and a separate PT opengrep-reanchor push both got blocked by guard-sync-divergence, both times because /tmp itself was the scanned WORKSPACE_ROOT and picked up other same-session disposable clones (pt-reanchor-agy, pt-reanchor-codex, periscope-work2, etc.) as false 'siblings ahead of canonical.' Both times resolved by moving the canonical worktree into its own isolated parent directory (e.g. <local-tmp-file>/<repo>) before pushing, which shrinks WORKSPACE_ROOT to contain nothing else.
